title: Real recorder session promotion
minimumPromotionPolicy: Recorder promotion requires runtime RECORD_AUDIO prompt ownership, foreground microphone disclosure with stop action, ResourceRegistry-backed session handles, scoped temporary output ownership, crash and provider-destroy cleanup, packaged start/stop stress, stable denial without capability or Android permission, and raw object denial.

requiredArchives.requiredEvidence: Runtime RECORD_AUDIO prompt and denial/grant archive covering interactive and packaged flows, stable errors, Android permission metadata, and Safe downgrade behavior.
Foreground microphone disclosure and stop-action archive proving user-visible ownership, notification cleanup, task removal behavior, and rollback cleanup.
Scoped temporary output archive proving owner-scoped paths, no raw file descriptors, delete-on-stop/delete-on-destroy behavior, quota enforcement, and failure cleanup.
ResourceRegistry session archive proving provider destroy, process death, app relaunch, crash recovery, and Safe downgrade stop owned sessions without touching external media.
Packaged recorder start/stop stress archive covering relaunch, task removal, missing capability, missing Android permission, denied prompt, quota, and temporary file cleanup.
